title: Analysts Are Bullish on These Healthcare Stocks: GE Healthcare Technologies Inc (GEHC), Nuvation Bio (NUVB) - The Globe and Mail
summary: Analysts Are Bullish on These Healthcare Stocks: GE Healthcare Technologies Inc (GEHC), Nuvation Bio (NUVB) The Globe and Mail
body:
There’s a lot to be optimistic about in the Healthcare sector as 3 analysts just weighed in on GE Healthcare Technologies Inc (GEHC), Nuvation Bio (NUVB) and Fortress Biotech (FBIO) with bullish sentiments.

In a report released today, Rick Wise from Stifel Nicolaus maintained a Buy rating on GE Healthcare Technologies Inc, with a price target of $98.00. The company’s shares closed last Tuesday at $69.73.

According to TipRanks.com, Wise is a 1-star analyst with an average return of -2.0% and a 45.0% success rate. Wise covers the Healthcare sector, focusing on stocks such as Kestra Medical Technologies Ltd., Treace Medical Concepts, and Zimmer Biomet Holdings. ;'>

Currently, the analyst consensus on GE Healthcare Technologies Inc is a Moderate Buy with an average price target of $91.69, a 30.2% upside from current levels. In a report issued on March 24, TipRanks – PerPlexity also upgraded the stock to Buy with a $80.00 price target.

See the top stocks recommended by analysts >>

In a report released today, Gregory Renza from Truist Financial reiterated a Buy rating on Nuvation Bio, with a price target of $4.51. The company’s shares closed last Tuesday at $4.51.

According to TipRanks.com, Renza is a 5-star analyst with an average return of 17.8% and a 46.4% success rate. Renza covers the Healthcare sector, focusing on stocks such as Ascentage Pharma Group International Unsponsored ADR, Perspective Therapeutics, and Abivax SA Sponsored ADR. ;'>

Currently, the analyst consensus on Nuvation Bio is a Strong Buy with an average price target of $11.93, which is a 173.6% upside from current levels. In a report issued on March 27, Wedbush also maintained a Buy rating on the stock with a $11.00 price target.

In a report released today, Scott Henry from Alliance Global Partners maintained a Buy rating on Fortress Biotech, with a price target of $4.50. The company’s shares closed last Tuesday at $2.35.

According to TipRanks.com, Henry is a 1-star analyst with an average return of -1.8% and a 39.4% success rate. Henry covers the Healthcare sector, focusing on stocks such as Palatin Technologies, Tenon Medical, Inc., and Sensus Healthcare. ;'>

Currently, the analyst consensus on Fortress Biotech is a Moderate Buy with an average price target of $10.75.
